elements.element: The exit obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must, at Customer’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees assistance for at least 90 days, but does not grant Customer the right to assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rates or payment terms for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must “export and deliver to Customer all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer” in its possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export and delivery obligation must be completed “within thirty (30) days following such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery but specifies no standard or machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The original provision permits either return or destruction of Confidential Information, but neither it nor the added paragraph requires deletion of Customer Data after delivery.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification obligation is included.

elements.element: The exit obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph expressly applies upon both expiry and termination.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance for “at least ninety (90) days” following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must export and deliver Customer data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must export and deliver to Customer all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer that is in Kubient’s possession or control.

elements.element: The data export must occur within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly imposes a 30-day deadline following expiry or termination.

result.reason: The redline cleanly reaches the fallback by covering both expiry and termination, providing at least 90 days of transition assistance, and requiring delivery of Customer data within 30 days. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits six-month availability, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, post-delivery deletion, and deletion certification. The addition is narrowly directed to exit assistance and data return and does not displace unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is reduced by the open-ended phrase “at least ninety days,” the absence of transition-assistance pricing, and the lack of format and deletion mechanics.
